title: Text tools with gmatch and gsub
description:
Write four functions:

```lua-norun
split(s, sep)            -- the pieces of s between each sep, keeping empty pieces; sep is plain text
                         -- (it may be "." or "%" and means that character); split("a,,b", ",") is { "a", "", "b" }
words(s)                 -- the words of s in lower case, as a list; a word is a run of letters and apostrophes
fill(template, values)   -- every {name} in template replaced by tostring(values[name]);
                         -- a {name} with no value is left as it is
title_case(s)            -- the first letter of every word upper case, the rest of the word lower case
```

```lua-norun
words("Don't PANIC, it's fine.")              --> { "don't", "panic", "it's", "fine" }
fill("{who} has {n} items", { who = "Ada", n = 3 })   --> "Ada has 3 items"
title_case("the LORD of the rings")           --> "The Lord Of The Rings"
```
hints: `s:find(sep, start, true)` finds plain text from position `start`, which avoids every pattern problem with `.` and `%`.
In `fill`, a replacement function that returns `nil` keeps the original `{name}`. Test `values[name] ~= nil`, so that `false` is still filled in.
unitTests:
test("split keeps empty pieces", function()
    check_eq(split("a,,b", ","), { "a", "", "b" })
    check_eq(split("red,green,blue", ","), { "red", "green", "blue" })
    check_eq(split("", ","), { "" })
    check_eq(split(",x,", ","), { "", "x", "" })
    check_eq(split("no separator", ","), { "no separator" })
end)

test("split with special and long separators", function()
    check_eq(split("1.2.3", "."), { "1", "2", "3" })
    check_eq(split("50%off%now", "%"), { "50", "off", "now" })
    check_eq(split("a::b::c", "::"), { "a", "b", "c" })
end)

test("words", function()
    check_eq(words("Don't PANIC, it's fine."), { "don't", "panic", "it's", "fine" })
    check_eq(words("  "), {})
    check_eq(words("one-two 3 three"), { "one", "two", "three" })
end)

test("fill", function()
    check_eq(fill("{who} has {n} items", { who = "Ada", n = 3 }), "Ada has 3 items")
    check_eq(fill("{a}{a}{b}", { a = "x" }), "xx{b}")
    check_eq(fill("no fields", {}), "no fields")
    check_eq(fill("{flag}", { flag = false }), "false")
end)

test("title case", function()
    check_eq(title_case("the LORD of the rings"), "The Lord Of The Rings")
    check_eq(title_case("x"), "X")
    check_eq(title_case("  two  spaces "), "  Two  Spaces ")
end)
